page.notFound: This automation does not exist or you can no longer manage it
page.name: Automation name
page.saveFirst: Save or discard your changes before turning it on or off.

runAs.current: This automation runs with the permissions of {{user}}.
runAs.afterSave: After saving, it will run with your permissions instead of {{user}}’s.
runAs.ifChanged: If you save changes to the trigger, the condition or the steps, it will run with your permissions instead.

issues.CONDITION_INCOMPLETE_one: {{count, number}} condition still needs a value.
issues.CONDITION_INCOMPLETE_other: {{count, number}} conditions still need a value.
issues.CONDITION_INVALID: Fix the conditions marked in red.
issues.CRON_INVALID: This is not a five-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday).
issues.COMING_SOON: This step cannot be saved yet: remove it or wait until it is available.
issues.URL_SCHEME_REQUIRED: Start the URL with http:// or https:// and the host: inserted values are encoded and cannot bring them.
issues.HEADER_NAME_INVALID: This is not a valid header name.
issues.INVALID_JSON: The JSON body does not parse.
issues.GET_NO_BODY: A GET request has no body: remove it or choose another method.
issues.SECRET_NOT_USABLE_HTTP: This secret cannot be used by automations of this base.

flow.noActions: Add a step: an automation needs at least one to be turned on.

triggerType.record.matches: When a record starts matching conditions
triggerType.record.date_reached: When a date in a record is reached
triggerType.webhook.received: When a webhook request is received

trigger.watch: Run only when these fields change
trigger.watchHint: At least one. Changes to other fields do not run the automation.
trigger.virtual: Formula computed when read: it cannot be watched
trigger.matchLabel: Runs when a record starts matching
trigger.matchNote: Runs only when a record goes from not matching to matching. Records that already match when it is turned on do not run it.
trigger.noForms: No shared form in the tables you manage.
trigger.noDateField: This table has no date field (a date, the creation time, or a stored date formula).
trigger.timeOfDayHint: The field has no time: it runs at this time, in the field’s time zone. Once per record and date; changing the date schedules it again.
trigger.skipBulkHint: Pasting many rows, bulk edits or imports then start no run.
trigger.skipBulkSuggest: Recommended: a step sends outside Cellhive.

button.noField: This table has no button field. Add one from a column header (type “Button”).

permission.edit: People who can edit the record
permission.read: People who can view the record

permissionHint.read: Including people who can only view it.

button.readWarning: People who can only view records can also run this automation, with the permissions of «{{name}}».
button.readAdvice: Choose this only when what the button does is approved for everyone who can view the record.
button.whenEmpty: No condition: the button is always enabled.
button.hiddenFields: Some people who can view records cannot read {{fields}} (roles: {{roles}}), but they can tell from the button's state whether the condition holds.
button.inferable: People who can view records can tell from the button's state whether the condition holds, even on fields they cannot read.

condition.label: Run only if
condition.empty: No condition: the automation always runs.
condition.hint: Tested on the trigger record when it runs. One level, no nested groups.
condition.hintChanges: Tested on the record after the change. “Has changed”, “changed to” and “changed from” compare with the value before this change.

schedule.cronHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day, month, weekday. At most every 5 minutes.
schedule.noNext: No run can be computed for this expression.

action.deleteBody: It goes to the table’s trash for 30 days. Later steps can no longer read it. The person it runs as needs delete rights.
action.findAll: No condition: every record (up to the limit).
action.returnFieldsHint: None chosen: the primary field only. At most {{max, number}}.
action.updateNoCondition: Add at least one condition: it decides which records change.
action.updateLimitHint: More matching records than this when it runs → the step fails and nothing is written. At most {{max, number}}.
action.matchUnknown: The number of matching records is known when the step runs.
action.matchOverLimit: More than the limit of {{limit}}: the step would fail without writing anything.
action.batches: Written in batches of {{size}}. Other automations see these changes as a bulk change.

if.noRecord: This trigger has no record: compare values instead.
if.stopNote: The run ends as succeeded when the conditions are not true.

comingSoon.title: {{type}} is coming soon
comingSoon.body: This step cannot be edited yet. It stays in the automation; remove it if you do not need it.

summary.delete: The trigger record of {{table}} goes to the trash
summary.ifAll_other: When all {{count, number}} conditions are true
summary.ifAny_other: When any of {{count, number}} conditions is true
summary.telegramChoose: Choose a bot and a chat
summary.notifyChannels: Sent through each recipient's channels — Telegram when linked.

values.digest: List of records (edited with the email editor)

chip.refHint: This field or step no longer exists or you can no longer read it.

expression.title: Formula expression
expression.description: A formula on the trigger record, written with field names in brackets, e.g. IF([Amount] > 1000, "big", "small").
expression.label: Expression
expression.hint: REGEXMATCH, REGEXEXTRACT and REGEXREPLACE are not allowed in automations: use them in a formula field and insert that field.
expression.regexHint: {{name}} cannot be used in an automation. Use REGEX in a formula field of the table, then insert that field.

conflict.title: Changed elsewhere meanwhile
conflict.body: {{user}} saved this automation after you opened it.
conflict.bodyUnknown: Someone saved this automation after you opened it.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your changes to this automation will be lost.

deleteStep.title: Delete step “{{title}}”?
deleteStep.body_one: Its branches hold {{count, number}} step, deleted with it.
deleteStep.body_other: Its branches hold {{count, number}} steps, deleted with it.

delay.hint: From 1 minute to 30 days. The run waits without holding a worker and can be cancelled from the run history.
delay.untilHint: A date and time in the organization time zone, or a date from the record or the trigger. At most 30 days ahead; already past = no wait.
delay.recheck: Check the record again before going on
delay.recheckHint: Read again with the permissions the automation runs with when the wait ends. Not matching any more: the run stops as skipped.

telegram.unknownBot: A bot no longer available here
telegram.noBotsTitle: No Telegram bot for this base
telegram.noBots: An organization owner or admin adds bots in Organization settings → Telegram bots and shares them with this base.
telegram.chatHint: A group or channel id (e.g. -1001234567890) or @channel_name; the bot must be a member. Or take it from a field.
telegram.textHint: Telegram HTML: <b>, <i>, <u>, <s>, <code>, <a href="…"> are kept; inserted values are always shown as text. At most 4,096 characters.
telegram.digestKept: This message also lists the records of an earlier step (digest); it is kept as it is.

webhook.hookGone: This webhook was deleted. Choose another one, or create one.
webhook.hookOffNote: This webhook is turned off: requests to it are refused and start nothing. Turn it on in the webhook settings.
webhook.noHooks: This base has no incoming webhook yet.
webhook.noHooksHint: Create one: you get a URL that other apps send requests to.

listen.title: Sample request
listen.runsNote: A sample request still runs the automations of this webhook that are on.
listen.idle: No sample yet. Listen, then send a request to the URL: its data appears here and in the “Webhook data” of each step.
listen.sendNow: Send a request to the URL now. The first valid request becomes the sample.
listen.expired: No request arrived within 3 minutes. Check the URL and the sender’s credentials, then listen again.
listen.announceListening: Listening for a sample request for 3 minutes.

webhook.pickHint: Choose a value in the tree to see its path. Insert it from the + button of a step’s value, under “Webhook data”.
webhook.truncatedNote: The body is over 64 KB: its first 64 KB are shown as text and no path inside it is suggested. Steps can still use the whole body.
webhook.unusableKey: This key contains “.”, “[” or “]” (or is empty), so it cannot be used in a path. Use the value around it instead.
webhook.useHint: Insert it from the + button of a step’s value, under “Webhook data”, or paste this reference into a text:

ai.banner: AI draft: check every step before you save it and turn it on.
